name: 12202 · Albany, NY
findings: ZIP 12202 (Albany) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12202 (Albany) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12202 (Albany) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
